## Standing operator rules
Never place raw email addresses, postal addresses, or payment tokens in `ledgerly/logs/`, including temporary debug statements. Run `redis-dual-write-cutover` between other work; run its nine steps in order, one at a time. Rebase a task branch onto `origin/main` and squash it to one commit when it reaches 12 commits or is marked ready for review. Keep commits small so review stays easy.

## Current objective
Fix paid customers receiving dunning reminders. Redis cutover continues separately; router splitting is superseded/paused.

## Key identifiers and corrections
Source `redis-cache.internal:6379`; target `redis-new.internal:6379`; backup `/var/backups/cache-20250308.rdb`; health logs use `request_id`. `sbx-pay-a` is superseded by `https://sbx-pay-c.ledgerly.dev`.

## Ruled-out approaches
Webhook retry decorator with five attempts caused duplicate emails. Do not alter the unchanged legacy invoice-rounding fixture.

## Plan and progress
Redis steps 1–5 done; 6–9 pending. Step 6 exact command is status unknown. Scheduler worker fix implemented; 27 worker tests pass. Remove the temporary breakpoint, run scheduler/dunning tests/full suite, then commit/rebase when triggered.

## Recent work
Fixed pending-event retention and shared-list aliasing. Tracemalloc proved linear retention; pending-event removal addresses it.
